open import Relation.Binary.PropositionalEquality using ( trans )

*-distribʳ-+ : ∀ (m n p : ℕ) → (n + p) * m ≡ n * m + p * m
*-distribʳ-+ m zero p = refl
*-distribʳ-+ m (suc n) p =
  trans (cong (m +_) (*-distribʳ-+ m n p)) (+-assoc m (n * m) (p * m))
